cup.name: FA Cup
cup.participants: 747 entrants; 124 in the main competition (92 Premier League/EFL clubs + 32 qualifiers). Premier League and Championship clubs enter at the third round.
cup.winner_gets: UEFA Europa League league phase + FA Community Shield
cup.quote: The FA Cup is a knockout competition with 124 teams taking part from the first round proper, and all trying to reach the final at Wembley Stadium on 16 May 2026.
cup.winner_quote: This is the second consecutive (and third overall) edition of the tournament to be played without replays in the proper rounds since 2020-21.

super_cup.name: FA Community Shield
super_cup.entrants: Premier League champions vs FA Cup winners (league runners-up if one club wins both)
super_cup.quote: an annual association football match contested by the winners of the previous season's Premier League and FA Cup competitions. It was played at Wembley Stadium in London on 10 August 2025

cup.name: Copa del Rey
cup.participants: 126 clubs from La Liga down to the sixth tier; the four Supercopa clubs enter at the round of 32. Preliminary round two-legged.
cup.winner_gets: UEFA Europa League league phase + 2027 Supercopa (both finalists)
cup.quote: Single match at Estadio de La Cartuja, Seville. Both teams qualified for the 2027 Supercopa de España.
cup.winner_quote: The winners were assured a place in the 2026-27 UEFA Europa League league stage.

super_cup.name: Supercopa de España
super_cup.entrants: La Liga winners and runners-up + Copa del Rey winners and runners-up; next-placed league clubs fill overlaps
super_cup.quote: The tournament was to feature the winners and runners-up of the 2024-25 Copa del Rey and 2024-25 La Liga.

cup.name: Coppa Italia
cup.participants: 44 clubs (20 Serie A, 20 Serie B, 4 Serie C); Serie A's top eight enter at the round of 16.
cup.winner_gets: UEFA Europa League league phase + Supercoppa Italiana
cup.quote: Round of 16 (one-legged): the eight winners were joined by Serie A clubs, seeded 1-8 ... Semi-finals (two-legged): the four winners faced each other. Final (one-legged): the two winners faced each other.
cup.winner_quote: The winner automatically qualifies for both the UEFA Europa League league phase and the Supercoppa Italiana the following year.

super_cup.name: Supercoppa Italiana
super_cup.entrants: Serie A winners and runners-up + Coppa Italia winners and runners-up
super_cup.quote: The tournament featured the winners and runners-up of the 2024-25 Serie A and 2024-25 Coppa Italia.

cup.name: DFB-Pokal
cup.participants: 64 clubs: 18 Bundesliga + 18 2. Bundesliga + top four of the 3. Liga + 21 regional cup winners + 3 extra regional slots.
cup.winner_gets: UEFA Europa League league phase + Franz Beckenbauer Supercup
cup.quote: Teams met in one game per round. ... If still tied after regulation, 30 minutes of extra time were played ... If the score was still level after this, the match was decided by a penalty shoot-out.
cup.winner_quote: The winner of the DFB-Pokal would normally have earned automatic qualification for the league phase of the 2026-27 edition of the UEFA Europa League.

super_cup.name: Franz Beckenbauer Supercup (DFL-Supercup)
super_cup.entrants: Bundesliga champions vs DFB-Pokal winners; hosted by the cup winner
super_cup.quote: an annual football match contested by the winners of the previous season's Bundesliga and DFB-Pokal competitions. The match was played on 16 August 2025.

cup.name: Coupe de France
cup.participants: 14 rounds from regional level; 18 Ligue 1 clubs enter at the round of 64 (46 qualifiers + 18 Ligue 1).
cup.winner_gets: UEFA Europa League league phase + Trophée des Champions
cup.quote: date = 11 mai 2025 - 22 mai 2026 ... nombre d'épreuves = 14 tours ... site = Finale au Stade de France
cup.winner_quote: The final is played at the Stade de France and the winner qualifies for the league phase of the UEFA Europa League and a place in the Trophée des Champions match.

super_cup.name: Trophée des Champions
super_cup.entrants: Ligue 1 champions vs Coupe de France winners; league runners-up if one club wins both
super_cup.quote: It took place on 8 January 2026 at the Jaber Al-Ahmad International Stadium in Kuwait City, Kuwait. The match was contested by Paris Saint-Germain, the winners of the 2024-25 Ligue 1 and Coupe de France titles, and Marseille, the runners-up of the 2024-25 Ligue 1.

cup.name: KNVB Cup
cup.participants: 64 clubs in the first round: 18 Eredivisie + 16 Eerste Divisie (reserve teams excluded) + Tweede Divisie and amateur district-cup qualifiers through two preliminary rounds.
cup.winner_gets: UEFA Europa League league phase + Johan Cruyff Shield
cup.quote: It was concluded on 19 April 2026 with the final played at De Kuip in Rotterdam, in which AZ Alkmaar won the trophy for the fifth time.
cup.winner_quote: The winners would qualify for the 2026-27 UEFA Europa League and the 2026 Johan Cruyff Shield.

super_cup.name: Johan Cruyff Shield
super_cup.entrants: Eredivisie champions vs KNVB Cup winners; played at the champion's ground
super_cup.quote: an annual Dutch football match played between the winners of the previous season's Eredivisie and KNVB Cup.

cup.name: Taça de Portugal
cup.participants: 149 clubs: 18 Primeira Liga (enter R3), 15 Liga Portugal 2 (R2), 18 Liga 3, 54 Campeonato de Portugal, 44 district clubs; 38 clubs get a bye in R2.
cup.winner_gets: UEFA Europa League league phase + Supertaça Cândido de Oliveira
cup.quote: The four winners of the quarter-finals were paired without any conditions. Each pairing was contested in two home-and-away matches.
cup.winner_quote: As cup winners, Torreense qualified for the 2026-27 UEFA Europa League league stage.

super_cup.name: Supertaça Cândido de Oliveira
super_cup.entrants: Primeira Liga winners vs Taça de Portugal winners; runners-up if one club wins both
super_cup.quote: It was played between the winners of the 2024-25 Primeira Liga and the 2024-25 Taça de Portugal, Sporting CP, and the runners-up of the 2024-25 Primeira Liga and the 2024-25 Taça de Portugal, Benfica, on 31 July 2025.

cup.name: Turkish Cup (Ziraat Türkiye Kupası)
cup.participants: 155 clubs; four single-leg preliminary rounds reduce the field to 24 for a group stage of 3 groups of 8; 8 clubs (3 winners, 3 runners-up, 2 best third-placed) reach the quarter-finals.
cup.winner_gets: UEFA Europa League play-off round + Turkish Super Cup
cup.quote: Ön eleme turu ve eleme aşamasındaki maçlar tek maç eleme usulüne göre oynanır. ... Grup aşaması 8 takımlı 3 grupta oynanacak.
cup.winner_quote: The winner of the competition qualifies for the play-off round of the UEFA Europa League and also competes in the Turkish Super Cup against the Süper Lig champions.

super_cup.name: Turkish Super Cup
super_cup.entrants: Süper Lig winners, runners-up and third place + Turkish Cup runners-up (cup winner's slot passes down when a club wins the double)
super_cup.quote: In May 2025, it was announced that the competition would be changed from a two-team format to four teams, which would include a semi-final round. The matches were played as single-elimination games at neutral venue(s).

cup.name: Copa do Brasil
cup.participants: 92 clubs; first two rounds single-leg, from the third round every tie is two-legged including the final.
cup.winner_gets: Copa Libertadores group stage + Supercopa do Brasil
cup.quote: The competition is a single elimination knockout tournament featuring two-legged ties (in the third round onwards).
cup.winner_quote: As champions, Corinthians qualified for the 2026 Copa Libertadores group stage and the 2026 Supercopa do Brasil.

super_cup.name: Supercopa do Brasil
super_cup.entrants: Campeonato Brasileiro Série A champions vs Copa do Brasil champions
super_cup.quote: an annual football match played between the champions of the Campeonato Brasileiro Série A and Copa do Brasil.

cup.name: Copa Argentina
cup.participants: 64 clubs from all levels of the pyramid; single-leg knockout in every round, final at a neutral ground.
cup.winner_gets: Copa Libertadores group stage + Supercopa Argentina
cup.quote: The round was played in a single knock-out match format between 22 January and 17 April 2025.
cup.winner_quote: As winners, Independiente Rivadavia qualified for the group stage of the 2026 Copa Libertadores and earned the right to play the winners of the 2025 Trofeo de Campeones in the 2025 Supercopa Argentina.

super_cup.name: Supercopa Argentina
super_cup.entrants: Trofeo de Campeones winners vs Copa Argentina winners
super_cup.quote: an annual football match contested by the winners of the Trofeo de Campeones de la Liga Profesional and Copa Argentina competitions. It was contested between Estudiantes (LP) ... and Independiente Rivadavia ... on 12 November 2026.

cup.name: Copa MX
cup.participants: none - the national cup has been suspended since 2020
cup.quote: It was not held during several periods (1976-1987, 1992-1994, 1997-2012), and since 2020 it has been on hiatus.

super_cup.name: Campeón de Campeones
super_cup.entrants: Liga MX Apertura champion vs Clausura champion
super_cup.quote: It took place on 20 July 2025 between América, the Apertura 2024 champion, and Toluca, the Clausura 2025 champion. The match took place at Dignity Health Sports Park in Carson, California ... the Campeón de Campeones was contested at a neutral venue in the United States.

cup.name: U.S. Open Cup
cup.participants: 96 clubs: MLS, USL Championship/League One/Two, NPSL, UPSL and local qualifiers; MLS clubs playing in the CONCACAF Champions Cup field their reserve sides.
cup.quote: The winner, Nashville SC, qualified for the 2026 CONCACAF Champions Cup.

cup.name: Emperor's Cup
cup.participants: 88 clubs: 20 J1, 20 J2, amateur designated teams and 47 prefectural cup winners; J1 clubs enter at the round of 16.
cup.winner_gets: AFC Champions League Two + Japanese Super Cup
cup.quote: Due to the participation of Urawa Red Diamonds in the 2025 FIFA Club World Cup, they were given automatic qualification to the Round of 16 of the Emperor's Cup.
cup.winner_quote: The winning club qualifies for the AFC Champions League and the Japanese Super Cup.

super_cup.name: Japanese Super Cup (Fujifilm Super Cup)
super_cup.entrants: J1 League champions vs Emperor's Cup winners; league runners-up if one club wins both
super_cup.quote: It was held on 8 February 2025 between the 2024 J1 League champions and Emperor's Cup winners Vissel Kobe and the 2024 J1 League runners-up Sanfrecce Hiroshima

cup.name: Chinese FA Cup
cup.participants: 64 clubs: 12 qualifiers + 20 League Two in R1, 16 League One enter in R2, 16 Super League clubs enter in R3; single-leg throughout.
cup.quote: First round ... 14-16 March 2025 ... Third round ... 20-21 May 2025 ... 16 Chinese Super League teams ... Final ... 6 December 2025
cup.winner_quote: continental_cup_title = 2026-27 AFC Champions League Elite; continental_cup_qualifiers = Beijing Guoan

super_cup.name: Chinese FA Super Cup
super_cup.entrants: Chinese Super League champions vs CFA Cup winners; league runners-up if one club wins both
super_cup.quote: an annual football match contested by the winners of the previous season's Chinese Super League and FA Cup competitions. The match was played between Shanghai Port ... and Shanghai Shenhua, the runners-up of the 2024 Chinese Super League.

cup.name: Egypt Cup
cup.participants: 72 clubs; two preliminary rounds, Nile Premier League clubs enter at the round of 32; extra time only from the round of 32.
cup.quote: The competition began with a first preliminary round featuring 72 teams. Nile Premier League clubs will enter the tournament at the Round of 32. Extra time will only be applied starting from the Round of 32
cup.winner_quote: Pyramids triumphed over the defending champions ZED with an 2-1 victory, securing a place in the Egyptian Super Cup.

super_cup.name: Egyptian Super Cup
super_cup.entrants: Egyptian Premier League winners + Egypt Cup winners + League Cup winners + one EFA golden-card invite
super_cup.quote: The tournament consists of four teams: the winners of all three major football competitions in Egypt from the preceding season (Egyptian Premier League, Egypt Cup and Egyptian League Cup), while the fourth team is invited by receiving a 'golden card' from the Egyptian Football Association.

cup.name: King's Cup
cup.participants: 32 clubs: 18 Pro League + 14 First Division; straight knockout from the round of 32.
cup.winner_gets: AFC Champions League Two group stage + Saudi Super Cup
cup.quote: The tournament began on 31 August 2025 and concluded with the final on 8 May 2026.
cup.winner_quote: The winner qualifies to the group stage of the 2026-27 AFC Champions League Two.

super_cup.name: Saudi Super Cup
super_cup.entrants: Pro League and King's Cup winners and runners-up; next-placed league club fills a double
super_cup.quote: The tournament was supposed to feature the winners and runners-up of the 2024-25 King's Cup and 2024-25 Saudi Pro League. However, since Al-Ittihad were both the Pro League and King's Cup winners, the extra spot was awarded to the Pro League third-placed team.

cup.name: Australia Cup
cup.participants: 718 entrants overall; 32 in the main competition (A-League clubs + member-federation qualifiers).
cup.winner_gets: AFC Champions League Two group stage
cup.quote: As winners, the Newcastle Jets would have qualified for the group stage of the 2026-27 AFC Champions League Two.
